ENM Identity and Access Management System Administrator Guide (2/1543-AOM 901 151-1).

stories.title: Rel. 26.3 - vLITP Time Shift Test Execution.
stories.description:
Execute the Time Shift Test on cENM as indicated in the following steps:

 
 * Step 7 - Certificate configuration
 * Step 8 - Change the NTP in the future and align all the blades to the new date
 * Step 10 - Check Security Certificates not managed by PKI
 * Step 11 - Check the NSS SW Version
 * Step 12 - Align Netsim Server date to the NTP
 * Step 13 - Update the NSS_CA as external CA in ENM
 * Step 14 - Apply future certs on Netsim VM nodes
 * Step 15 - Add Node Licenses on ENM server
 * Step 16 - Run RFA250 test
 * Step 17 - Workload Set Up
 * Step 18 - Run Node populator to add/synch nodes
 * Step 19 - Run PM Workload profiles
 * Step 20 - Check Workload profile results

as reported in the following confluence page:
[https://eteamspace.internal.ericsson.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=2902588433]

*Acceptance Criteria:*
This US defines all the steps to perform vLITP Time Shift execution test in the future time (+ 10 years):
starting from certificate configuration to run of PM Workload Profiles.

as reported in the following confluence page:
